items.name_html: the ask parks in one visible transition
items.body_html: the HELP_REQUEST fact and the help_pending park land in the SAME atomic commit (the human_gate precedent) — there is never a half-asked state
the HELP_REQUEST transcript entry IS the op_id-carrying fact for the emit — no separate generic envelope append, so audit and idempotency read one record, not two

the reply commit keeps current_step, does not advance the round, and deliberately does NOT call apply_target_entry_effects — same position without re-arrival; the self-target route (which genuinely re-arrives) stays a different thing
the next dispatch's handoff is derived from the transcript (HELP_REQUEST → HELP_REPLIED pairs by request_ref), never from wait-state memory — record, not replay

items.name_html: an undeclared or unauthorized ask starts nothing
items.body_html: no step.help declaration ⇒ help_not_declared; outside the capability ⇒ not_authorized; a malformed payload ⇒ missing_required_field — all before any state change

items.name_html: the wait-slot home admits one open ask
items.body_html: "≤ 1 open help" is a property of the blocking variant's marker HOME (the single wait slot), not of the help errand per se — the deferred non-blocking form homes its markers in a record collection
